Regina confirmed Tiny Mike made it to safety after the Militech raid and closed Concrete Cage Trap. This does not establish that V personally escorted him all the way to the waiting transport, or that he remained safe forever afterward.
Regina confirmed Lucy Thackery reached safety and closed Hippocratic Oath. This does not establish whether V helped Lucy finish treating the Maelstrom patient.

Regina acknowledged receiving Max Jones safely and closed Freedom of the Press. This record does not by itself distinguish whether he agreed to go or was brought in unconscious, and does not establish his later opinion of V.
Regina recorded Hal Cantos as safe and closed Occupational Hazard. His rescue does not establish whether Anna Nox was killed or subdued, or make Regina an eyewitness to the warehouse fight.

V installed the stabilizing shard and completed the subsequent conversation with Chang-Hoon Nam; Wakako acknowledged the work and closed her contract. Nam was responsive at that stage. This is not a diagnosis or a guarantee of permanent recovery.

Wakako confirmed Lauren Costigan was secure, said she was informing Bradley, and closed We Have Your Wife. The confirmation concerns the completed rescue; it does not reveal every detail of Lauren and Bradley's private reunion.

Muamar confirmed Jasmine Dixon reached the escape transport and closed Cuckoo's Nest. This does not establish that V escorted every step, a psychiatric diagnosis, consent to later treatment, or the long-term outcome of returning to her husband.

Flavio reached the nomad contact, and Muamar confirmed Flavio had spoken to him afterward and closed Going-away Party. This does not establish that Sixth Street forgot him or that every later threat was eliminated.

Padre reported that Gustavo Orta died by suicide and accepted that reported result as closing the contract. This is Padre's report, not evidence that V or a companion witnessed the death, not proof V killed Gustavo, and not proof of what V said to him.

Wakako acknowledged the outcome in which V released Alex, the corporate prisoner in Sergei's trunk, and closed Olive Branch while alluding to competing payments. The record does not establish what subsequently happened to Sergei or Alex.

Dino explicitly accepted V persuading Jack Mausser to leave as resolving An Inconvenient Killer and closed the contract. This is an accepted nonlethal alternative; it does not establish Mausser's later location, later death, or every word spoken in the VIP room.
